create_mineru_loader: create a MinerULoader instance to parse a PDF document using the local MinerU API
test_mineru_local_api: test the MinerULoader with local API mode to parse a document synchronously
build_mineru_cloud_parser: build a MinerULoader with cloud API mode to parse a document asynchronously using presigned upload URLs
refactor_mineru_params: refactor the MinerULoader constructor to support configurable OCR, formula, table extraction, and language parameters
review_mineru_load: review the MinerULoader.load method and its routing between local and cloud API modes
